photos.desc: A fossilized Acrocanthosaurus trackway near the Canyon Lake Gorge at Canyon Lake, Texas, United States estimated to be 110 million years old.
Trackway from the Paluxy River in Texas and a Apatosaurus excelsus skeleton at the American Museum of Natural History.
Head of Acrocanthosaurus atokensis , a theropod from the Early Cretaceous of North America, pencil drawing
Acrocanthosaurus was a meateating dinosaur from America of the cretaceous period. It was 12 meter long, and weighed about 2, 5 tonnes. Relatives were Allosaurus .
